fourSeparateDimensions.rationale: §3 T0-B3: a single ordered enum would incorrectly treat HOST_OBSERVED, ADMITTED and CURRENT as interchangeable levels of truth.

identityRules.nodeId: tn-<32 hex> = canonicalDigest({domain:'palimpsest.trajectory.node.v1', schemaVersion, ownerPlane, ownerScope, canonicalId, sourceSequence, sourceDigest, projectId})

edgeInvariant: evidenceState === ESTABLISHED_BY_OWNER_REFERENCE ⟺ evidence !== null; every other state carries evidence === null

noGenericCausedByEdge.reason: §3: do not generate generic CAUSED_BY edges merely from adjacency. No relation name in TRAJECTORY_RELATIONS contains 'CAUS'; adjacency is emitted only as SAME_OWNER_SEQUENCE_SUCCESSOR with evidenceState TEMPORAL_ONLY.

workEventValidation.parser: parseSchedulerEvent (owner parser; recomputes request_digest AND event_digest, so a mutated payload with a stale digest is refused)
checks: causation reference must be an EARLIER same-project event (CAUSATION_NOT_EARLIER)
non-genesis interval requires an explicit validated predecessor basis (MISSING_PREDECESSOR_BASIS, PREDECESSOR_BASIS_MISMATCH)
workEventValidation.nonGenesisCausationRule: A causation_id below the interval's first event is accepted ONLY because a validated predecessor basis was supplied and event_id is strictly increasing; without that basis validation has already refused.

basisVector.observationWindowProtocol: read basis → read history → read basis → compare; a moved basis marks the window RACED rather than silently re-reading
basisVector.explicitStatement: This is an optimistic observation protocol, not a global distributed transaction.

historicalFactRetained: verification outcomes available at that time

hostEvidenceBoundary.reason: G1-B's Correlator still exposes caller-controlled trust admission surfaces and does not enforce every claimed Run/Claim/Readback relationship for all inputs, so its returned string is recorded and never promoted.
